payload.title: File:Phdinoleatherpic.jpg
payload.description_html: This is a leather picture made by Phroziac, and photographed by her. The design is from a tandy doodle page, the dyes were denatured alcohol based, except for the white, which is water based. It has a lacquer finish on it, with a modified wooden frame. I got reserve champion at the county fair for this. I also got four ribbons from 4-H spring achievment, Outstanding workmanship, Outstanding presentation, participation, and Originality. I am sorry about the shinyness, this is because I had to use flash, and the lacquer finish is shiny..
